# WORLD-P0-A Performance Observations

**Work item:** WORLD-P0-A (worker-a, reality substrate contracts)
**Machine-readable record:** `measurements.json` (generated by
`packages/world-reality-substrate/scripts/measure.ts`, committed with
this evidence tree).

Honesty rules for this document:

1. All numbers below are REAL measurements of the RUNNABLE parts of the
   delivered package, executed in this sandbox (bun 1.3.14, Linux x64),
   recorded once. Timings are single-host observations — they are NOT
   gates, NOT reproducible wall-clock claims, and NOT vendor benchmarks.
   The deterministic parts (corpus sizes, outcomes, digests,
   byte-identity) ARE reproducible and are asserted by the committed
   test battery.
2. Real-SUBSTRATE performance (Babylon.js, CesiumJS, OpenUSD, native
   Assimp) is **BLOCKED** for this wave: P0 adopts no substrate (by the
   program's own acceptance detail), so there is nothing real to
   measure. Fabricating vendor numbers would violate the honesty laws.

---

## Measured: the GLB parser + canonical extraction (real, in-sandbox)

Deterministic corpora (synthetic GLBs, seeded coordinate pattern),
parse + full canonical extraction, per run after one declared warm-up:

| Corpus | Input size | Per run |
|---|---|---|
| 100 triangles | 4,724 B | 0.191 ms |
| 1,000 triangles | 42,528 B | 0.352 ms |
| 10,000 triangles | 420,536 B | 1.745 ms |
| 100,000 triangles | 4,200,540 B | 15.097 ms |

Observed scaling is near-linear in input bytes (≈3.6 µms/B at the 100k
scale; ≈0.15 ms per 1k triangles at the small end) — consistent with the
single-pass container decode + one-pass extraction design. The
determinism assertion held on every corpus: two independent parses
produced byte-identical canonical streams and identical sha-256
digests.

## Measured: the composition engine (real, in-sandbox)

| Corpus | Per run |
|---|---|
| 2 layers × 2 opinions | 0.030 ms |
| 8 layers × 2 opinions | 0.027 ms |
| 32 layers × 2 opinions | 0.128 ms |

Flat for small stacks (candidate collection is linear in opinions, not
exponential in arcs); 32-layer composition stays sub-millisecond.

## Measured: the ingest parsers and geodesy (real, in-sandbox)

| Corpus | Per run |
|---|---|
| Canonical STL tetrahedron (513 B) | 0.015 ms |
| PLY grid: 4,000 vertices / 2,000 faces (94,163 B) | 3.265 ms |
| Vincenty inverse, 55 km-class canonical line | 0.001 ms |

Geodesy correctness anchors (deterministic, asserted in tests):
Flinders–Buninyong 54,972.271 m (Vincenty's published vector, matched to
<1e-3 m); quarter equator = a·π/2 exactly; 1-degree equatorial arc exact
to 5e-8 m.
